title: OFM timeline.json
description: Per-world manifest. Discovered by gaia/discovery as /srv/ofm/<world>/timeline.json.

url.description: Public URL slug, leading slash. Conventionally /<world_dir_name>.

size.description: World size hint used by the renderer; 1=tiny … 5=galaxy. Most fantasy continents use 3.

date.description: In-world year (or ISO date string) at which to display.

mode.description: Storage backend. postgis = shared PG host, spatialite = local .db, geojson = files under raw/geojson/, orbitals = procedurally-generated space.

visible.description: Whether this world appears in the world picker. Defaults to true.

modifiable.description: Whether the editor should permit writes.

base.description: Default map center + zoom on first load.

connection.description: Storage connection details. Only `db` is required for the standard PG/SpatiaLite setup.

color.description: Named color/palette key consumed by frontend (e.g. 'blue-bell').

tags.description: Free-form tags used by the world picker.

sources.description: Static-data sources for this world. Mostly used by the rendering pipeline.

wikis.description: Map of wiki-slug → wiki metadata; consumed by gaia_agent and gaia for lore lookups.

search.description: Search index hints — which layers/fields the global search should look in.

tracks.description: Live-tracking table for MQTT-driven moving entities.

events.description: Name of the table that holds in-world events.

star.description: Parent star name for orbital worlds.
